# Imperial Mortgages

> Imperial Mortgages is a mortgage advisory in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We compare home loan offers from UAE banks and guide buyers from pre-approval to property transfer at the Dubai Land Department Trustee office. We serve UAE nationals, UAE residents and non-resident buyers.

## Contact

- Website: https://imperialmortgages.ae/

## Services

- Resident mortgages: for salaried and self-employed buyers living in the UAE. Up to 80% financing on a first home up to AED 5M. Employed applicants: minimum salary from AED 15,000 at most banks.
- Non-resident mortgages: for overseas buyers in Dubai freehold areas, typically up to 50–60% financing.
- Off-plan handover finance: a mortgage arranged in time for the final handover payment.
- Buyout and refinance: moving an existing mortgage to a better rate, including equity release.
- Islamic home finance: Ijara and Murabaha structures compared alongside conventional mortgages.
- Commercial property finance: offices, retail and warehouses, usually 50–60% financing.

## Key UAE mortgage rules (used in our calculator)

- Maximum loan-to-value set by the UAE Central Bank for a first home: expat residents 80% up to AED 5M and 70% above; UAE nationals 85% up to AED 5M and 75% above.
- Debt burden ratio: total monthly debt repayments may not exceed 50% of monthly income.
- Typical purchase costs in Dubai: DLD transfer fee 4% of the price + AED 580; mortgage registration 0.25% of the loan + AED 290; Trustee office fee about AED 4,200; bank valuation about AED 3,150.
- A property worth AED 2M or more can qualify the owner for the UAE 10-year Golden Visa route.
- Maximum loan term: 25 years.

## Process

1. Discovery call (day 1): income, residency and the property you have in mind.
2. Compare and pre-approve (days 2–5): offers compared across lenders; pre-approval usually valid 60 days.
3. Valuation and offer (days 6–15): after the MOU (Form F) is signed, the bank values the property and issues the final offer.
4. Transfer (weeks 3–6): the title deed is issued at the Trustee office.
